SECTION: DOTC01 §12-§13 — is the CURRENT architecture capable of organiser-level turnover?
THE_QUESTION: does the current state space and transition law admit ANY regime in which a daughter forms, stays nonempty, gains a constituent, loses a constituent, keeps producing X locally, and does not proliferate out of control?
THE_ANSWER_IS_ALREADY_IN_THE_DATA: the question does not need a feasibility argument at all, because the phenomenon has ALREADY OCCURRED. Four centres in the surviving PQEC01 B1 set complete a constituent turnover inside one continuous identity interval, and three of them keep producing X locally on both sides of the removal. An existence proof by observation supersedes any bound.

STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.requirement: a mechanism for local replenishment INSIDE an existing centre
STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.why: the Y birth branch of _react_core fires only at cells with nY > 0, so every newborn Y is co-located with an existing constituent and lands inside that centre by construction. The engine's replenishment mechanism is intrinsically intra-centre.

STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.requirement: co-located Y can form a persistent multi-constituent centre under the scheduler
STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.why: observed max N_Y in one centre reached 3; single-linkage at CORE_R = 5.0 keeps co-located and near constituents in one component

STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.requirement: a removal rate that produces turnover without forcing extinction first
STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.why: birth and death hazards at B1 are of the same order — mean local birth hazard 8.680e-05 per step against muY = 9.261e-05, ratio 0.9373 — so neither swamps the other. The exact chain gives P(complete turnover by horizon) = 0.11664 against P(extinct before turnover) = 0.25524.

STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.requirement: a birth rate high enough for replacement without uncontrolled new centres
STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.why: PREMATURE_THIRD_CENTRE accounts for 0.1591 of B1 stops, so proliferation is present but bounded, and 28 of 44 worlds never exceeded one centre.

STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.requirement: local X function survives the removal
STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_WHERE_EACH_I.why: 3 of 4 turnover centres record exact X births at their own cells on both sides of the removal

THE_FOUR_CANONICAL_CONFLICTS_AND_THEIR_S.death rate high enough to create turnove: REFUTED BY OBSERVATION — 4 centres completed turnover; 3 kept producing afterwards for 99, 217 and 5644 further steps
THE_FOUR_CANONICAL_CONFLICTS_AND_THEIR_S.co-located Y cannot form a persistent mu: REFUTED BY OBSERVATION — N_Y reached 2 and 3 inside single components
THE_FOUR_CANONICAL_CONFLICTS_AND_THEIR_S.the engine has no mechanism for local re: REFUTED STRUCTURALLY — Y birth is Y-gated and therefore intrinsically intra-centre

WHY_NOT: the standard requires a PROOF that the current state variables and transition laws cannot support a continuously functioning centre through constituent turnover. The opposite has been observed. No architecture change is proposed, considered or implied.
WHY_NO_NEW_POINT: §12 asks for a new design only if NO existing point can produce constituent turnover. B1 produces it. No sweep, no interpolation, no new point.
